ACTION: Run `scripts/sdd-workspace specs/plans/12-tide-cache.md` to get the workspace path, then `cat "$WORKSPACE/progress.md"` and `git log` to confirm that Tasks 1 to 3 are complete and that Task 4 is not yet marked.

ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/resuming.md`. The skill requires this after a compaction, before any dispatch.

ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. My memory of it did not survive the compaction. It decides how the re-review runs and when to adjudicate.

ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/file-handoffs.md` for the BASE rule and the review-package contract.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package specs/plans/12-tide-cache.md BASE HEAD` for the Task 4 round 2 fix. Use the BASE that the rule gives. Keep only the path that the script reports.

ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/re-review-prompt.md` to fill the template.

ACTION: Dispatch the scoped re-review for Task 4 with model `sonnet`. The prompt names the diff file path, the open findings from the last review, and the plan's global constraints, copied word for word. It asks for an ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED verdict on each finding. I raise the model to `opus` only if the fix diff is subtle or risky.

Resuming Task 4. I am checking the ledger and the fix-loop rules first. Then I send the round 2 fix to a scoped re-review.
